blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Chinese Embassy Spokesperson Ji Lingpeng denied on Monday that the Chinese government had “funneled funds” to a public official in the Philippines. The denial came a few days after former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV alleged that CALE88, a company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Atty. Manases Carpio, received P319 million in cash remittances from China. “The Chinese Embassy in the Philippines has noted that recently certain Philippine politicians fabricated and spread a false narrative alleging that China had funneled funds to a particular political faction in the Philippines,” Ji said in a statement.
